visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing glasses and a burgundy top with a brown apron is seen in a professional-looking kitchen studio. She is adjusting a camera mounted on a large, heavy-duty floor slider system. The background features bright studio lighting and kitchen cabinets. (2) A close-up shows a pumpkin cut in half on a wooden board. A tiny, digitally-inserted miniature version of the woman stands on the pumpkin, waving. (3) The woman is shown putting a whole pumpkin into a black pot on a white stovetop. She then lifts the lid to reveal the steamed pumpkin. (4) Close-up of cooked pumpkin being mashed into a yellow paste in a glass bowl. The miniature woman appears again, 'walking' on the mash. (5) The woman operates a white stand mixer. We see the dough inside mixing at high speed. She then takes the yellow-tinted dough and performs a windowpane test, stretching it thin between her fingers to show its elasticity. (6) The dough is placed in a bowl for fermentation. The miniature woman is seen 'sleeping' under a piece of yellow dough as if it were a blanket. Later, a finger pokes the fermented dough to test its rise. (7) The woman rolls out the dough with a wooden rolling pin and shapes it into cylinders. These are placed into a rectangular black loaf pan. (8) After baking, the loaves are shown with a golden-brown top. The woman, wearing oven mitts, removes the toast from the pan. (9) The woman slices the pumpkin toast. She spreads more pumpkin mash onto a slice, sprinkles seasoning, and grills it in a pan with cheese. (10) The final shot shows the grilled sandwich being pulled apart, revealing melted, stretchy cheese inside, followed by a stack of the pumpkin loaves.

[Variety]: 踩 踩. (6) [Subtitle]: 拌進麵粉內. (7) [Subtitle]: 除了更有季節感也讓吐司的熱量稍微降低. (8) [Subtitle]: 纖維變多 GI值更低 吃起來更輕盈. (9) [Subtitle]: 發酵70分鐘 蓋個被子跟麵糰一起睡午覺吧. (10) [Subtitle]: 南瓜吐司的幾個操作重點. (16) [Subtitle]: 避免麵糰太脆弱長不大. (17) [Subtitle]: 最重要的是南瓜含糖量高容易上色. (18) [Subtitle]: 要比平常熟悉的吐司烤溫再降個5-10度. (19) [Subtitle]: 才不容易烤焦. (20) [Subtitle]: 我覺得烘焙最迷人的地方是能用同一份麵糰. (21) [Subtitle]: 做出屬於不同季節的味道. (28) [Subtitle]: 連很怕南瓜味的小當家都嗑了兩個. (29) [Subtitle]: 南瓜吐司很美吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a soft mechanical whirring sound of a camera slider, followed by the female narrator's clear, friendly greeting. The BGM, a bright acoustic guitar track with a light shaker rhythm, starts immediately. (2) As the pumpkin appears, a light 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of the miniature woman. (3) A metallic 'clink' is heard as the pot lid is moved. The narrator's speech is steady and informative. (4) Squishing and mashing sounds of the pumpkin are emphasized in the mix. (5) The mechanical hum of the stand mixer enters, layered with the continuous BGM. A 'whoosh' transition marks the shift to the dough test. (6) A soft 'thud' SFX occurs when the finger pokes the dough. The miniature woman's 'snoring' is represented by a whimsical, soft digital tone. (7) Rolling sounds and the sound of hands handling dough are audible. (8) A sharp 'click' or 'clink' signifies the bread pan hitting the counter. (9) Crisp, crunchy sounds of the bread being sliced and the sizzle of the pan are prominently featured as sound effects. (10) The final phase ends with a satisfying 'stretch' sound effect as the cheese pulls apart, blending into the narrator's closing question and a final musical flourish.
